note: Every row is checked by scripts/check-conformance.mjs: the references must resolve, and ENFORCED requires both enforcement and a pinning test.

requirements.requirement: A task MUST declare a type, a rigor level and an owner at every stage
pinnedBy: test:a new task is queued in specify and owned by the coordinator

requirements.requirement: specify MUST NOT end without a spec and an acceptance criterion
pinnedBy: test:the specify stage cannot end without a spec and an acceptance criterion

requirements.requirement: A task carrying an external action MUST be L3
pinnedBy: test:an external action must be L3 - L1 and L2 are both refused

requirements.requirement: An L3 task MUST answer the three intake questions even without --important
pinnedBy: test:an L3 task must state the three start choices, even without --important

requirements.requirement: No two live tasks may hold an overlapping resource
pinnedBy: test:a resource held by a live task cannot be claimed by another task

requirements.requirement: A refused claim MUST name the resource and its holder
pinnedBy: test:a resource held by a live task cannot be claimed by another task

requirements.requirement: A resource lock is held for a stage, not for the life of the task
pinnedBy: test:claim and complete release the lock between stages

requirements.requirement: Exactly one agent holds a task; only the holder may act on it
pinnedBy: test:a held lock rejects a second agent

requirements.requirement: A stale lock MUST be recoverable, and the recovery recorded
pinnedBy: test:recover clears a stranded lock, keeps the phase and re-queues the task

requirements.requirement: State MUST be written atomically under an exclusive lock
pinnedBy: test:four concurrent creates: every task survives (no lost update)

requirements.requirement: Roster lookups MUST use own properties, not the prototype chain
pinnedBy: test:a route named after a prototype member is ignored, not resolved

requirements.requirement: The record MUST carry status, owner, current step, next step and evidence
pinnedBy: test:a missing field fails: a successor cannot resume without it

requirements.requirement: The precedence claim MUST be positive; a negated one MUST be refused
pinnedBy: test:a negated precedence claim does not satisfy the requirement

requirements.requirement: The record outranks the queue at runtime
requirements.note: The engine checks the record but does not reconcile it against the queue; precedence is a rule agents follow with a timestamped entry (F-011).

requirements.requirement: The verifier MUST NOT be the implementer at L2 and L3
pinnedBy: test:the verifier is never the implementer (every type)

requirements.requirement: An important task MUST NOT self-verify at any level
pinnedBy: test:an important task may not self-verify, even at L1

requirements.requirement: A verification PASS MUST arrive with criterion-linked evidence
pinnedBy: test:a verification PASS must carry its witness

requirements.requirement: A failed verification MUST block done and dispatch to evidence
pinnedBy: test:the gate cannot be walked past: no done without a pass or an override

requirements.requirement: At L3 the verifier MUST NOT be an author of the task's evidence
pinnedBy: test:an L3 verifier may not also be an author of the evidence

requirements.requirement: Consequential work MUST pass a domain review by a domain-qualified third party
pinnedBy: test:an L3 task refuses to run when no domain-qualified third party exists

requirements.requirement: E1 MUST carry a command, an exit code and a revision
pinnedBy: test:E1 evidence carrying explicit nulls is refused, not just undefined

requirements.requirement: E2 MUST name a peer, and the peer MUST NOT be the author
pinnedBy: test:E2 must name a peer, and the peer must not be the author

requirements.requirement: An ungraded sentence MUST be recorded as E3 with a note
pinnedBy: test:a bare evidence string is stored as E3 and labelled, never as E1

requirements.requirement: E4 MUST say what is planned
pinnedBy: test:E4 must say what is planned

requirements.requirement: The per-level floor: L1 any grade, L2 E1/E2, L3 E1
pinnedBy: test:L2 requires E1 or E2 evidence: a self-report cannot close it

requirements.requirement: E1 attests that the command actually ran
requirements.note: E1 is a structural check, not provenance: the engine confirms the fields exist, not that the command ran. A runner-generated receipt is the fix (F-012).

requirements.requirement: An external action at its step MUST NOT be dispatched before approval
pinnedBy: test:an unapproved external action blocks its own step, not the internal stages

requirements.requirement: The approval scope MUST equal the action's target
pinnedBy: test:an approval scope must EQUAL the action target, not merely appear in it

requirements.requirement: An approval MUST record an approver and a scope
pinnedBy: test:approval requires both approvedBy and scope

requirements.requirement: The approver's identity is authenticated
requirements.note: The approver is an unauthenticated string; the queue is a local JSON ledger. This is a discipline with a record, not an authorisation server (F-003, F-011).

requirements.requirement: Three failed verifications MUST block the task
pinnedBy: test:three failed verifications block the task instead of retrying forever

requirements.requirement: A blocked task MUST refuse claims, completions and approvals
pinnedBy: test:a blocked task refuses claim, complete and approve

requirements.requirement: Recovery MUST be explicit and MUST state a reason
pinnedBy: test:recover requires a reason and refuses unrecoverable tasks

requirements.requirement: A non-dispatchable task MUST NOT be reported as success
pinnedBy: test:dispatch throws for non-dispatchable tasks

requirements.requirement: Engagement MUST require a curated keyword and an act of coordinating
pinnedBy: test:activation engages on how people describe the problem

requirements.requirement: A comparison or evaluation request MUST NOT auto-engage
pinnedBy: test:activation stays silent on ordinary requests that share a word

requirements.requirement: Ambiguous phrasing MUST be surfaced, not guessed
pinnedBy: test:ambiguous requests are surfaced as POSSIBLE, never guessed

requirements.requirement: The gate MUST inject known faults and reject every one
pinnedBy: gate:the description becomes a plain scalar containing a colon (the GitHub YAML error)

requirements.requirement: SKILL.md frontmatter MUST parse, not merely contain the keys
pinnedBy: gate:the description becomes a plain scalar containing a colon (the GitHub YAML error)

requirements.requirement: Shipped text files MUST be LF so scripts run where they are unpacked
pinnedBy: gate:a shipped file reverts to CRLF

requirements.requirement: The published artifact MUST be LF-clean, executable, complete, and MUST NOT name the repository
pinnedBy: step:artifact
requirements.note: Pinned by the checker's own negative self-test rather than a test-suite name: it builds the artifact, then builds one from a copy of the tree with the address pasted into a shipped file, and requires the second to be refused.
